# Base Models with UUIDv7 Primary Keys — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Ship gorm-parity base models (`fusion.Model` uint64 + `fusion.UUIDModel` UUIDv7) where UUIDv7 IDs are generated by the ORM at create time.

**Architecture:** A precompiled `PKGenerator` closure on `schema.Field` (same pattern as `Appender`/`Scanner`/`IsZero`), invoked by the create callback next to `setTimestamps`. The migrator maps the `type:uuid` tag to native `uuid` (PG) / `TEXT` (SQLite). Base structs live in a new root `model_base.go`.

**Tech Stack:** Go 1.27, `github.com/google/uuid` v1.6.0 (already indirect; promoted to direct), modernc.org/sqlite, pgx/v5.

## Global Constraints

- Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-21-base-model-uuidv7-design.md` (approved).
- No panics in library code; wrap errors with `%w` and field context.
- No per-row reflection in hot paths beyond the existing `fieldAt` pattern; closures resolved at table-init time.
- Integration tests run against real SQLite temp files; PG tests skip cleanly when `FUSION_TEST_PG_DSN` is unset.
- Table-driven tests beside the code they cover; exported symbols get doc comments.
- Every task: `go test ./...` green before commit; final gate `go vet ./...`.

### Task 1: `schema.Field.PKGenerator` — UUIDv7 closure resolved at table init

**Files:**
- Modify: `schema/field.go` (Field struct ~line 30-64, newField ~line 176-243)
- Test: `schema/field_test.go`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `Field.PKGenerator func(reflect.Value) error` — set only for primary-key fields of type `uuid.UUID` without `autoincrement`. Later tasks call it with the addressable field value; it must leave a non-zero v7 UUID in `v` on success.

	ID   uuid.UUID `fusion:"pk,type:uuid"`
	Name string
}

func TestPKGeneratorGeneratesUUIDv7(t *testing.T) {
	table, err := NewTables(nil, false, nil).Parse(&uuidPKModel{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	field := table.Field("ID")
	if field.PKGenerator == nil {
		t.Fatal("PKGenerator not resolved for uuid pk")
	}
	v := reflect.New(reflect.TypeFor[uuid.UUID]()).Elem()
	if err := field.PKGenerator(v); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PKGenerator: %v", err)

	id := v.Interface().(uuid.UUID)
	if id == (uuid.UUID{}) {
		t.Fatal("id still zero")

	if id[6]>>4 != 7 {
		t.Errorf("version nibble = %d, want 7", id[6]>>4)
	}
	if id[8]>>6 != 2 {
		t.Errorf("variant nibble = %d, want 2 (RFC 9562)", id[8]>>6)
	}
}

		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if field := table.Field("ID"); field.PKGenerator != nil {
		t.Error("PKGenerator set on autoincrement pk")
	}
}

func (postWithUUID) TableName() string { return "uuid_posts" }

func setupUUIDModelDB(t *testing.T) *DB {

	dsn := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "uuidmodel.db")

	if err != nil {

func TestCreateFillsUUIDv7ID(t *testing.T) {
	db := setupUUIDModelDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := db.WithContext(ctx).Exec(`CREATE TABLE uuid_posts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)`).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	post := postWithUUID{Title: "hello"}
	if err := db.WithContext(ctx).Create(&post).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create: %v", err)
	}
	if post.ID == (uuid.UUID{}) {
		t.Fatal("id not generated")
	}
	if post.ID[6]>>4 != 7 {
		t.Errorf("version nibble = %d, want 7", post.ID[6]>>4)
	}
	var found postWithUUID
	if err := db.WithContext(ctx).First(&found, "id = ?", post.ID).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("round trip: %v", err)

	if found.Title != "hello" {

	}

	db := setupUUIDModelDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := db.WithContext(ctx).Exec(`CREATE TABLE uuid_posts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)`).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	preset := uuid.Must(uuid.NewV7())
	post := postWithUUID{ID: preset, Title: "preset"}
	if err := db.WithContext(ctx).Create(&post).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create: %v", err)
	}
	if post.ID != preset {
		t.Errorf("preset id overwritten: got %v want %v", post.ID, preset)
	}
}

func TestCreateBatchUniqueUUIDs(t *testing.T) {
	db := setupUUIDModelDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := db.WithContext(ctx).Exec(`CREATE TABLE uuid_posts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)`).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	posts := make([]postWithUUID, 5)
	for i := range posts {
		posts[i].Title = "batch"
	}
	if err := db.WithContext(ctx).Create(&posts).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("batch create: %v", err)

	for _, p := range posts {

		}
		if seen[p.ID] {
			t.Fatalf("duplicate id %v", p.ID)
		}
		seen[p.ID] = true
	}
}

```go
	for i := range values {

Add the helper near `setPrimaryKeyValue` in the same file:

```go
// applyPKGenerators fills zero primary keys whose dialect-agnostic generator
// was resolved at table init (uuid v7). Pre-set ids are respected.
func applyPKGenerators(table *schema.Table, value reflect.Value) error {
	for _, field := range table.Fields {
		if field.PKGenerator == nil {
			continue
		}
		fv := fieldAt(value, field.Index)
		if !fv.IsValid() || !fv.CanSet() || !field.IsZero(fv) {
			continue
		}
		if err := field.PKGenerator(fv); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("generate %s: %w", field.DBName, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `model_base.go`**

Create `model_base.go` in the root package:

```go
package fusion

// Base models: gorm.Model parity for fusion-orm. Embed by value to inherit
// the primary key, automatic timestamps, and soft-delete DeletedAt.

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Model is the numeric base model, mirroring gorm.Model: an autoincrement
// primary key backfilled after insert, automatic CreatedAt/UpdatedAt, and a
// nullable DeletedAt that enables soft delete.
type Model struct {
	ID        uint64    `fusion:"pk,autoincrement"`
	CreatedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt time.Time
	DeletedAt DeletedAt `fusion:"index"`
}

// UUIDModel replaces Model's numeric ID with a UUIDv7 primary key generated
// by the ORM at create time whenever the field is zero. Pre-set IDs are
// respected.
type UUIDModel struct {
	ID        uuid.UUID `fusion:"pk,type:uuid"`
	CreatedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt time.Time
	DeletedAt DeletedAt `fusion:"index"`
}
```

and add below `sqlType`:

```go
// mappedSQLType translates known portable type aliases per dialect. Only
// recognized aliases are remapped; everything else passes through verbatim.
func (m *Migrator) mappedSQLType(sqlType string) string {
	if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(sqlType), "uuid") {
		if m.has(feature.PostgreSQLTypes) {
			return "uuid"
		}
		return "TEXT"
	}
	return sqlType
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: README "Model conventions" section**

Insert after the "Migrations" feature bullet (line ~79 area), or as a new `## Model conventions` section before "Comparison":

```markdown
## Model conventions

Embed `fusion.Model` or `fusion.UUIDModel` by value to inherit an ID, automatic
timestamps, and soft delete (gorm `Model` parity):

```go
type User struct {
    fusion.UUIDModel
    Email string `fusion:"unique"`
}

// fusion.Model: autoincrement uint64 ID, backfilled from LastInsertID/RETURNING.
// fusion.UUIDModel: UUIDv7 ID generated by the ORM at create time when zero.
```

`Delete` soft-deletes (sets `deleted_at`); `Unscoped()` hard-deletes, and
`Unscoped().Delete()` variants bypass the soft-delete filter, as in gorm.
`type:uuid` columns use native `uuid` on PostgreSQL and `TEXT` on SQLite.
```
